_note: Route-existence sweep: scale-free (Barabasi-Albert) networks, UNLIMITED capacity. Varies edges-per-new-entity x entity count x depth, over seeds 1-3. Scale-free graphs are always connected (every new entity attaches to the existing graph), so here the interesting variable is DEPTH: can a route be found within D hops, not whether one exists at all. The x-axis mean degree is ~2*edgesPerNode. Amount is a constant 10 (same across all four route-existence specs). See ../README.md and packages/tallysim/docs/design.md.
